title: NFC Wood & Bamboo Keychain Tag — FSC Eco-Credential
summary: NFC wood and bamboo keychain tags embed an NTAG213 / 216 or NTAG 424 DNA inlay inside a laser-engraved FSC- or PEFC-certified wood body (bamboo, walnut, maple, cherry) sourced under ISO 38200 chain-of-custody, cleared under the EU Deforestation Regulation (EU 2023/1115, EUDR) due-diligence framework, prior EUTR Regulation (EU) 995/2010, FLEGT voluntary-partnership regime, EN 71-3 heavy-metal migration for giveaway / child-safety use, EN 13986 E1 formaldehyde emission class on any glued composites, REACH + RoHS 3 on the inlay, and WEEE Directive 2012/19/EU end-of-life handling. Target use is corporate-gift + event-giveaway + sustainable-hotel + winery / brewery loyalty + ESG-audited promotional programmes where the credential has to demonstrably close the deforestation + toxic-substance + end-of-life audit.

brief.label: Form factor
items: Round Ø 35-45 mm / rectangle 30 × 45 mm / custom die-cut (brand silhouette); wood thickness 3-5 mm with NFC inlay laminated inside a 2-ply sandwich.
Mass 5-10 g with chip, ring and laser-engrave decoration; 304 / 316 stainless split ring, leather / cotton-cord / bamboo-bead loop options.

brief.label: Wood species options
items: Bamboo (Phyllostachys edulis) — fast-growing grass, 3-5 year harvest; lowest embodied carbon; FSC Bamboo / PEFC Bamboo available.
Walnut (Juglans regia / nigra) — dark grain, premium tactile feel; FSC Mix / FSC 100 % available from EU and North-American mills.
Maple (Acer saccharum / platanoides) — light, smooth, hard; high laser contrast; FSC / PEFC certified; preferred for high-detail engraving.
Cherry (Prunus serotina / avium) — warm red-brown; patina-forming; FSC / PEFC certified.

brief.label: Chain-of-custody + deforestation posture
items: FSC Forest Stewardship Council (FSC-STD-40-004) Chain-of-Custody — certificate number + product-of-origin on every order.
PEFC Programme for the Endorsement of Forest Certification — alternative chain-of-custody for continental-European sourcing.
ISO 38200:2018 — Chain of custody of wood, wood-based products and trees other than forests.
EUDR (Regulation (EU) 2023/1115) — operator due-diligence statement, geolocation of harvest plot, legality declaration; required for EU market placement from 30 Dec 2025.
Prior EUTR Regulation (EU) 995/2010 + FLEGT Regulation (EC) 2173/2005 VPA licensing retained for pre-EUDR audit trail.

brief.label: Chemistry + restricted substances
items: EN 71-3:2019+A1 migration of specified elements — required where keychain is distributed to children (< 14 yr giveaway, family-event programmes).
EN 13986 formaldehyde emission class E1 (≤ 0.124 mg/m³) on any glued composite wood body; prefer solid wood to avoid the audit entirely.
REACH (EC 1907/2006) SVHC candidate-list screen on varnishes, sealants and laser-burn residues; California Prop 65 declaration where applicable.
RoHS 3 (EU 2015/863) on the NFC inlay + solder + antenna etch.

brief.label: Air-interface envelope
items: 13.56 MHz HF — ISO/IEC 14443-3 + NFC Forum Type 2 Tag Technical Specification; NTAG213 ({chip:nxp-ntag-213:user_bytes} B) / NTAG215 ({chip:nxp-ntag-215:user_bytes} B) / NTAG216 ({chip:nxp-ntag-216:user_bytes} B) / NTAG 424 DNA SUN.
Wood is largely RF-transparent at 13.56 MHz; smartphone tap 2-4 cm matches ABS-housed NFC tags.

brief.label: Laser decoration
items: CO₂ laser engraving 30-60 W; depth 0.3-0.5 mm; feature size 0.2-0.5 mm; permanent, tactile, no fade.
Two-sided engraving supported (logo front / URL or QR back); variable-data serialisation at encode bench for per-unit QR or NDEF URL.

brief.label: Surface treatment
items: Food-grade beeswax / carnauba-wax finish — preferred for child-safety / giveaway posture; EN 71-3 migration cleared by construction.
Water-based polyurethane clearcoat — optional for pool-adjacent / outdoor duty; adds humidity resistance at the cost of the raw-wood tactile signature.
Oil finish (tung / linseed) — premium patina-forward finish; dries fully to a non-tacky skin-safe surface.

brief.label: Moisture + outdoor posture
items: Water-resistant (splash / rain tolerant) but not IP-rated; sustained submersion will warp or delaminate the 2-ply sandwich.
Not specified for pool-adjacent / aquatic / food-plant wash-down — specify silicone or epoxy keyfob for those environments.

brief.label: Use-case envelope
items: Corporate-gift + employee welcome kit + partner-gift programmes — FSC-certified walnut / bamboo + laser-engraved brand mark + NTAG 424 DNA SUN URL.
Event giveaways + conference / trade-show promotional NFC — bamboo + laser-engraved event logo + NDEF URL to event hub / photos.
Sustainable-hotel + eco-resort room-key or loyalty keepsake — walnut / cherry + debossed brand mark + DESFire EV3 or NTAG 424 DNA SUN for loyalty wallet.
Winery / brewery / distillery merchandise + tasting-room loyalty — cherry / walnut + tap-to-follow social / tasting-notes URL.
Real-estate closing-gift / agent-branded keychain — maple + laser-engraved agent card + vCard on NTAG216.
ESG-audited promotional programmes where FSC + EUDR + EN 71-3 + WEEE documentation must ship with every order.

brief.label: Sustainability arithmetic
items: Wood tag embodied carbon ≈ 12-25 g CO₂-eq per unit (FSC walnut, laser-engrave, NTAG213 inlay) vs ≈ 40-70 g CO₂-eq for ABS-housed plastic NFC of the same mass — roughly 2-3× lower.

End-of-life: wood body biodegradable; inlay + antenna goes to WEEE Directive 2012/19/EU recycling channel; finished tag is not mono-material biodegradable without bio-substrate inlay (in pilot — ask).

brief.label: Operational lifecycle
items: Field life 2-4 years on daily key-ring carry; retirement usually on ring-hole tear-out or surface abrasion losing the engraved mark legibility; chip itself outlasts the wood body.
Retirement: ring pulled, chip zeroised per NIST SP 800-88, wood body to general biodegradable / compost stream (where local policy allows), inlay to WEEE metal + PCB stream.

sections.title: Why a wood / bamboo NFC keychain is the credential that actually closes an ESG audit
bullets: Single-use PVC NFC giveaways fail every sustainability report they enter — plasticiser migration, petrochemical supply chain, no end-of-life story; a sustainable-brand audit rejects them on first review.

FSC / PEFC chain-of-custody + ISO 38200 gives procurement the per-lot certificate number and product-of-origin that goes straight into the annual CSRD / ESRS scope-3 report; PEFC is the easier EU-mill source, FSC carries the broader consumer recognition.

The EU Deforestation Regulation (EU 2023/1115) — EUDR — required operator due-diligence statements, harvest-plot geolocation and legality declarations for wood placed on the EU market from 30 December 2025; ProudTek ships the EUDR DDS with every EU order, and retains the prior EUTR (995/2010) + FLEGT audit trail.

Child-safety + family-giveaway programmes trigger EN 71-3:2019+A1 (migration of 19 specified elements including Pb, Cd, Hg, Cr(VI)) — food-grade beeswax or carnauba-wax finish passes EN 71-3 by construction; E1 formaldehyde class per EN 13986 closes the composite-wood audit.

End-of-life arithmetic: wood body biodegradable, NFC inlay goes to WEEE Directive 2012/19/EU metal + PCB stream; embodied carbon 12-25 g CO₂-eq per tag is 2-3× lower than ABS-housed plastic NFC of equal mass.

sections.title: Bamboo vs walnut vs maple vs cherry — picking the species
bullets: Bamboo (Phyllostachys edulis) — fast-growing grass, 3-5 year harvest, lowest embodied carbon; light-tan colour; hard; uniform grain; preferred for high-volume giveaway programmes with the strongest sustainability story.

Walnut (Juglans regia / nigra) — dark, premium tactile feel, rich grain variation; patina-forming on daily-carry; preferred for corporate-gift and eco-hotel arrival kits where the keyfob is a keepsake.
Maple (Acer saccharum / platanoides) — light cream colour, fine smooth grain, hard; highest laser-engraving contrast; preferred for high-detail engraving + QR code + variable-data serialisation.

Cherry (Prunus serotina / avium) — warm reddish-brown, satiny fine grain; patina deepens with UV exposure; preferred for winery / brewery / distillery loyalty merch where the warm tone carries the brand.
All four species are FSC / PEFC available; all four are EUDR-eligible via the operator DDS route; all four accept 0.3-0.5 mm CO₂-laser engraving with 0.2-0.5 mm feature resolution.

dataHighlight.heading: EU Deforestation Regulation (EU 2023/1115, EUDR) operator due-diligence deadline
dataHighlight.text: From 30 December 2025 the EUDR requires operators placing wood products on the EU market to submit a Due-Diligence Statement (DDS) via the EU information system, including country of harvest, geolocation of each plot, legality declaration and risk assessment. ProudTek wood NFC keychain tags carry the DDS + FSC / PEFC chain-of-custody certificate + ISO 38200 audit trail + prior EUTR Regulation (EU) 995/2010 + FLEGT VPA licence (where applicable) on every EU order. Wood NFC tags without that evidence pack cannot lawfully be placed on the EU market — making the FSC / PEFC + EUDR audited supply chain not a premium line, but the compliance floor.
dataHighlight.source: Regulation (EU) 2023/1115 on the making available on the Union market and the export from the Union of certain commodities and products associated with deforestation and forest degradation — Articles 3, 4, 8 and Annex I; cross-referenced against FSC-STD-40-004 v3.1 and ISO 38200:2018.

sections.title: How to roll out a wood NFC keychain programme without failing a sustainability, EUDR or EN 71-3 audit
bullets: Pick the species + finish first — bamboo / maple for volume giveaway + laser-engrave contrast; walnut / cherry for corporate-gift + hospitality premium; food-grade beeswax / carnauba-wax for child-safety posture; oil / polyurethane where humidity tolerance matters.

Require the FSC-STD-40-004 or PEFC chain-of-custody certificate + ISO 38200 per-lot evidence + EUDR operator DDS + EUTR / FLEGT audit trail on the PO; declare at least one chain-of-custody standard explicitly and ship the certificate number on the invoice.

Close the chemistry audit — EN 71-3:2019+A1 migration (child-safety giveaway), EN 13986 E1 formaldehyde class (glued composites only; prefer solid wood), REACH SVHC screen (varnish + sealant), RoHS 3 on inlay, California Prop 65 declaration; ship all certificates with the order.
Don't skip the stainless split ring — plated-steel rings rust and stain the wood body within 6-12 months; specify 304 or 316 stainless as a line item.

Pair with the right chip — NTAG213 for URL / social / vCard giveaway (cost-optimised); NTAG216 for larger NDEF payloads or variable-data serialisation; NTAG 424 DNA SUN for anti-cloning / loyalty wallet integration; DESFire EV3 where the keyfob doubles as building access.

Order end-of-life logistics — wood body to biodegradable / compost stream where policy allows; inlay + antenna to WEEE Directive 2012/19/EU metal + PCB recovery; chip zeroised per NIST SP 800-88 before disposal.

faq.question: Does wood attenuate the NFC read range?
faq.answer: Minimally. Dry wood is largely RF-transparent at 13.56 MHz, and our wood-sandwich construction optimises the antenna position inside the 3-5 mm body. Smartphone tap is 2-4 cm on a standard reader with a 22 × 22 mm inlay — functionally identical to an ABS-housed NFC tag. Very thick or moisture-laden wood can reduce range marginally; the water-based polyurethane or oil finish keeps moisture content low enough that this is not a field issue.

faq.question: How do FSC, PEFC and the EUDR fit together, and what do I need on the PO?
faq.answer: FSC (Forest Stewardship Council, FSC-STD-40-004) and PEFC (Programme for the Endorsement of Forest Certification) are both recognised chain-of-custody standards — FSC has stronger consumer recognition, PEFC has broader continental-European mill coverage. ISO 38200:2018 codifies the chain-of-custody audit. The EU Deforestation Regulation (EU 2023/1115, EUDR), in force for operators from 30 December 2025, requires a Due-Diligence Statement (DDS) with country of harvest, harvest-plot geolocation, legality declaration and risk assessment for any wood placed on the EU market. ProudTek ships the FSC or PEFC certificate number, ISO 38200 audit reference, and the EUDR DDS with every order; the prior EUTR (Regulation (EU) 995/2010) and FLEGT VPA licensing audit trail is retained for legacy evidence.

faq.question: Is the wood NFC tag child-safe for a family-event or kids' giveaway?
faq.answer: Yes — specify the food-grade beeswax / carnauba-wax finish (the default for child-safety programmes); the finish clears EN 71-3:2019+A1 migration of the 19 regulated elements (lead, cadmium, mercury, chromium VI and fellow-travellers) by construction, and passes EN 13986 E1 formaldehyde class (≤ 0.124 mg/m³) on any glued composite wood where composite is used at all (we prefer solid-wood bodies to avoid the audit entirely). The REACH SVHC candidate-list screen + RoHS 3 on the inlay + California Prop 65 declaration ship with every order. Do not specify polyurethane or solvent-based varnish for a child-safety programme — the finish stack is what drives the EN 71-3 pass.

faq.question: Are the tags waterproof enough for outdoor duty?
faq.answer: They are water-resistant but not IP-rated. Splash / rain tolerance is fine with any of our three finishes (beeswax, oil, water-based polyurethane); sustained submersion will warp or delaminate the 2-ply wood sandwich. For pool-adjacent, aquatic-centre, food-plant wash-down or industrial IP69K duty, specify silicone or epoxy keyfobs instead. The wood NFC tag is sized for daily pocket / key-ring carry with occasional outdoor exposure — conference lanyard, tasting-room giveaway, employee onboarding — not continuous wet-handling.
